result.text: In the mITTp population, eradication rate 84.7% for vonoprazan triple therapy vs 78.8% for lansoprazole triple therapy (difference 5.9%, non-inferior, p<0.0001); vonoprazan dual therapy 78.5% (difference -0.3%, non-inferior, p=0.007). In clarithromycin-resistant (mITTc) subjects, vonoprazan triple therapy 65.8% vs lansoprazole 31.9% (difference 33.8%, 95% CI 17.7% to 48.1%, superior, p<0.0001).

indication.text: VOQUEZNA TRIPLE PAK is a co-packaged product containing vonoprazan, amoxicillin, and clarithromycin, indicated for the treatment of Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) infection in adults.

citations.quote: VOQUEZNA TRIPLE PAK, is a co-packaged product containing vonoprazan, a potassium-competitive acid blocker (PCAB), amoxicillin, a penicillin class antibacterial, and clarithromycin, a macrolide antimicrobial, indicated for the treatment of *Helicobacter pylori* (*H. pylori*) infection in adults. (1.1)

target_moa.text: Vonoprazan is a potassium-competitive acid blocker (PCAB) that competitively inhibits the binding of potassium ions to the H+, K+-ATPase (proton pump), suppressing gastric acid secretion; it is co-packaged with the antibacterials amoxicillin (penicillin class) and clarithromycin (macrolide).

citations.quote: Vonoprazan is a potassium competitive acid blocker, a new class of acid-inhibitory agent. Vonoprazan competitively inhibits the binding of potassium ions to hydrogen potassium (H^+K^+)-ATPase (also known as the proton pump) in the final step of gastric acid secretion in gastric parietal cells.

key_safety.text: For VOQUEZNA TRIPLE PAK the most common adverse reactions (>=2%) were dysgeusia, diarrhea, vulvovaginal candidiasis, headache, abdominal pain, and hypertension. In HP-301, in the triple therapy arm rates were diarrhea 4.0%, dysgeusia 4.6%, vulvovaginal candidiasis 3.2%, headache 2.6%, abdominal pain 2.3%, and hypertension 2.3%. Overall TEAE incidence was 34.1% (triple), 29.9% (dual), and 34.5% (lansoprazole triple).
